items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: There were two fellows that I know made a profession of this who were sort of classmates... one was Bernard Flood

ctx.x: There were two fellows that I know made a profession of this who were sort of classmates, either one year before or after me -- one was Bernard Flood, a trumpet player who later worked with the Teddy Hill band in New York City.
